decision.rationale: The qualified index lifecycle removes the checkpoint-005 startup blocker while preserving the dataset, T0 conditions, deterministic gates, hidden-gold boundary, finite failure states, and USD 8 ceiling.
limitations: This is build-only evidence and does not measure product answer, citation, claim, boundary, or comparative quality.
The 500/100 package is a known development benchmark over open educational sources.
The advisory reviewers are separate OpenAI models from one provider family and are not independent external human annotation.
No provider, paid, private-data, final 10,000-case, T1, fidelity, visual, promotion, or deployment execution occurred.
